stoutford_artist_not_welcome.m: Leave! You are not welcome here.

r: Well, he probably deserived it. Whoever this person is.
Me? Nah. Not me. [Lie] I've never killed anybody.

stoutford_artist_palyer_killed_rubycrest.m: Yes, yes you most certainly killed him. His scent is all over your hands.
You killed my best friend! You killed the only thing I have to talk to up here on these hills.
r: Who did I kill? You are the only person up here that I've encountered.

stoutford_artist_palyer_killed_rubycrest.m: You killed the unique and exotic bird that calls these hills "home". My best friend! So I am now asking you to leave. [pointing his finger towards the door.]
r: I will stay. You are not the boss of me.

stoutford_artist_palyer_killed_rubycrest.m: You are to leave now. [pointing his finger towards the door.]
There's sorrow in you...maybe even regret. Perhaps you're not the monster I feared. Very well. You may stay, but only because I sense "warmth" in your heart and we won't speak of the bird again.

stoutford_artist_player_killed_rubycrest.m: ...wait a second. Hold that thought. [while leaning in...] Please come closer. [He sniffs your hands]

stoutford_artist_welcome_10.m: Oh, a visitor? Welcome! Come, come. Sit down.
r: No, thanks, I have to go.
Why are you up here alone?

stoutford_artist_welcome_15.m: Just a man with a brush and a view. I spend my days painting what others overlook.
r: Well, I'm just an explorer with a weapon.

stoutford_artist_welcome_16.m: Peace and perspective. Down there, it's noise and trade. Up here, I see everything more clearly.
